faqs.question: What are the opening and closing times of GYAN ADDA LIBRARY?
faqs.answer: GYAN ADDA LIBRARY is open 24 hours a day, Monday through Sunday, including holidays. Members can choose Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Full-Day, or 24-Hour access shifts.

faqs.question: What is the monthly fee structure and how do I enquire about current plans?
faqs.answer: Monthly self-study charges depend on your selected shift duration (single shift, double shift, full day, or 24-hour locker access). Contact our helpline at +91 87976 40034 or submit an admission enquiry for the exact current fee card.

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure at GYAN ADDA LIBRARY?
faqs.answer: Visit our study center at 2nd Floor, Station Rd, Mirzapur Chowk, Darbhanga or submit an online Admission Enquiry. Select your preferred study shift, verify your identity documents at the front desk, and complete registration.

faqs.question: Which documents are required for new admission?
faqs.answer: Applicants should carry one valid Government Photo ID (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving License / Student ID), two recent passport-size photographs, and an active mobile number & emergency guardian contact.

faqs.question: What study facilities are provided inside the reading hall?
faqs.answer: Every desk features comfortable ergonomic seating, individual LED desk lighting, dedicated power charging sockets, centralized air conditioning, RO chilled drinking water, clean sanitized washrooms, and 24/7 CCTV surveillance.

faqs.question: Is high-speed Wi-Fi available for online classes and mock tests?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide dual-band high-speed fiber Wi-Fi across all study halls so students preparing for UPSC, BPSC, SSC, NEET, JEE, and Banking exams can attend online lectures without buffering.

faqs.question: How do library attendance and shift check-ins work?
faqs.answer: Daily attendance is verified and recorded at the study hall desk according to your assigned shift. Accurate check-in timestamps and leave records help maintain seat discipline and safety.

faqs.question: How can parents or students reach the library help line?
faqs.answer: You can call us directly on +91 87976 40034 / +91 87897 02011, message on WhatsApp at +91 87976 40034, or use the Help Line Enquiry form on this website.

faqs.question: Is membership transferable between students?
faqs.answer: No. Every GYAN ADDA LIBRARY membership and assigned seat is strictly personal and non-transferable. Sharing ID cards or seat access with unregistered visitors leads to immediate cancellation.

faqs.question: How does seat reservation and shift allocation work?
faqs.answer: Seats are allocated strictly against your chosen study shift. Fixed full-day reserved seats remain held for you during active membership; shift-based members must vacate cleanly at the end of their shift window.

faqs.question: What are the key library discipline rules inside the reading hall?
faqs.answer: Pin-drop silence must be maintained at all times. Mobile phones must remain on silent mode, phone calls must be taken outside the hall, eatables are not allowed on study desks, and headphones must be kept at zero external sound leakage.

faqs.question: When should monthly membership be renewed to keep my reserved seat?
faqs.answer: Renewals should be completed on or before your billing due date to retain the same desk number. If you plan to be away on leave, please inform the desk administrator in advance so your seat reservation status can be updated.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for locker issues, Wi-Fi support, or emergency help?
faqs.answer: Contact the on-duty floor supervisor at the reception desk or reach our 24-hour help line at +91 87976 40034 / desk@gyanaddalibrary.in.
